scope: Independent static review of both frozen changes against 3b87599d27603195146afc36bb30e75ebda8af56; ccd6c36 adds planning tickets only. No implementation edits, tests, benchmarks, network or production actions by reviewer.

patch_summary.catalog: Retain eight needed source columns in non-search construction, stream saved-response flags, promote interactive columns once under the existing lock, and discard browse-only unused columns before take.
patch_summary.remote: DurableJournal retains one immediately checkpointed verified fact and appends it with the next normal event, flushing an older fact separately on consecutive verifications.

invariants_and_failure_paths: Catalog retained columns still include every grouping/identity/facet input; saved flags use the same saved_response decision and row order. No second grouping or review authority introduced.

Lazy list restoration owns the only new full-list read. Failed reload does not assign a partial table. Concurrent entry/search uses the existing reader lock. No documented or exercised search-after-close guarantee was found; other lazy operations already require open readers.

A payload always has an accepted durable original intent before its mutation. Delaying remote verification durability extends the existing uncertain-intent interval; restart must fully reconcile the payload rather than blindly repeat it.
One pending verification is protected by journal RLock. Consecutive completions flush the previous fact; completion and failure use the same append owner.

Combined events retain byte/event/count bounds, nonce/digest chain and IfNoneMatch sequence fencing. Failed append does not advance the sequence or discard its pending fact; lost acknowledgment is reconciled through exact nonce-bound readback.
Persisted verified ETags remain exact version guards. Missing last remote verification remains an uncertain original intent and is checked using complete current payload bytes.

test_evidence.execution: Reviewed recorded local test results and test bodies; no tests rerun by reviewer.

catalog.coverage: entry/search exact parity, Unicode/nested/direct-column reads, failed promotion state and retry, twelve concurrent calls with one promotion, reader closure

remote.coverage: immediate checkpoint, crash before append/full reconcile, consecutive/final flush, failed request/size admission before next payload, malformed embedded fact before checkpoint, lost ack without repeat, changed exact ETag, existing competing-runner/nonce guards and complete attempt conditions/readback

measured_result_review.catalog: Accepted run-2: logical retained source Arrow bytes 20405570 to 11455564, reduction 8950006 (43.8606%). Three samples per arm preserve all 269 payload hashes/sizes and all manifest values except published_at. Documentation accurately disclaims demonstrated speed or process-peak benefit.
measured_result_review.remote: One six-worker modeled-latency fixture: normal GET 833 to 724, PUT 821 to 712, HEAD 270 unchanged; 109 journal PUT/readback pairs removed (13.2765% fewer PUTs). PUT bytes 315587 to 296284; full body bytes read 319614 to 300311; fsync 2191 to 1973. Exact 269-payload/recovery comparison retained. Documentation correctly makes timing descriptive and count reduction schedule-dependent.
measured_result_review.verification_boundary: Independently hashed all 122 indexed raw receipt/log files and matched measured source hashes; relied on existing exact-output receipts rather than repeating payload generation or benchmarks.

structural_judgment.decision: Both are the smallest coherent transformations for the observed cost. Existing PyArrow operations, saved-response policy, journal serializer/guarded client and continuation owner remain authoritative.
structural_judgment.before_after: Catalog moves unused resident source data to one explicit lazy restoration point and drops discarded columns before copying. Journal separates persistence mechanics into _append and adds one bounded pending slot, avoiding a generic batch protocol or alternate publisher.
next_change_questions: If another interactive method needs list columns, can it use Catalog._ensure_list_columns rather than create another reload owner?
If another terminal publication event is added, does it use DurableJournal.record so the last pending fact is persisted?

residual_limits: Review is scoped static analysis plus verification of existing local evidence, not proof for every concurrent schedule.
Catalog measurements are a bounded retained fixture and measure logical Arrow bytes, not total retained native buffers or full-catalog RSS.
Remote timing is one tiny local fixture with modeled request latency; no hosted, live, browser or full-catalog performance qualification.
Root combined focused interaction test is separate from this independent review.
